## Getting Things Done!
DONATE
GET INVOLVED
About
Councilmember Diaz Nash
Thank you for visiting my website! I am honored to serve District 1 residents. Working together, we are ensuring City Hall responds to your needs by:
Fixing our potholes and streets
Protecting your 911 response, fire & paramedic services
Improving traffic, bicyclist & pedestrian safety
Keeping our public spaces, parks & facilities clean, and
Ensuring your views are reflected in all City decision-making.
As your full-time Councilmember, I will continue to fight for your interests during these dynamic, challenging times for our region and city.
Together, let’s maintain our neighborhood character, quality of life, and core services you expect and deserve. If I can provide constituent assistance to you or your family, please contact me at ldiaznash@cityofsanmateo.org.
